This archived one-commit branch introduced bounded disposable proof-workspace cleanup for the custom-stack, PostgreSQL-product, and package-product lanes. Current main retains all three cleanup surfaces and the deliberate-defect test suite, and strengthens the mechanism with exact disposable PostgreSQL namespace discovery, foreign/inaccessible residue handling, deleted-inode handling, and orphan PostgreSQL worker cleanup. Persistent product generations and durable receipt roots remain outside cleanup authority. Replaying the archived patch would therefore replace a stronger current lifecycle boundary with an older subset rather than recover missing behavior.

This one-commit branch introduced boot-enabled product service state, cross-controller receipt compatibility, and cold-boot identity proof. Current main retains the product-service-enablement/v1 and cold-boot readback implementation in tools/delivery/product_service_state.py, retains the corresponding product_service_state regression suite, and the current product-path hosted requirements lane executes the durable product service and cold-boot contract proof. Later activation work has extended package installation and immutable release handling without removing this service-state boundary. Replaying the older patch would therefore duplicate an implemented lifecycle contract on an obsolete base.
